_comment: Static, human-maintained guardrails for cuVSLAM eval, distinct from the rolling
nightly baseline in KPI_HISTORY (which changes every night).
SOFT drift check (WITHIN/DRIFT/SKIPPED/MISSING) stored in the report JSON. It never
fails the job. The keys checked are the ones the dataset registry says the suite
produces (run_eval.sh passes kpi-keys via -e/--expected_keys), so a new dataset
needs no entry here. 'tolerances' gives one tolerance per metric: 'tol_pct'
(percent of expected) or 'tol_abs' (absolute). A key without an 'expected' entry
is uncalibrated and SKIPPED. To calibrate, copy the steady-state value from a
trusted nightly kpi_<date>.json, e.g. "KITTI_ATE_MCAM_ODOM": 0.82, or give
Per-sequence failure checks, applied by cuvslam_kpi_report.py collect.
A sequence run fails if it tracked no frames, lost more than max_lost_frame_pct
of its frames, has no ATE, or its ATE exceeds max_ate_pct. Failures are counted
in the KPI tables (broken = fails in every configuration, flaky = in some) and
never fail the job. exclude_failed also drops failed sequences from the ATE, ARE
and Kabsch means; Losts and FPS always cover every sequence.
'datasets' overrides 'defaults' per KPI prefix (the <DATASET> part of a key).
